description: an enormous broad man in heavy grey steel plate armour with glowing cyan runes and gold trim, a helmet shaped like a castle tower with battlements, shoulder plates shaped like small castle towers, a short dark beard, a dark blue cloak hanging behind, no shield, no hammer and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the helmet to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, headwear, armour, cloak and colours; the hands empty, without the tower shield and the hammer
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
